justification: Dependency lower bounds and GitHub Action versions only, no application code. It redoes four Dependabot PRs (#1190, #1194, #1195) on a normal branch because Dependabot PRs cannot pass the gates here (no secrets, no QA report). Nothing the product serves changes.

falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the change, on origin/main 2026-11-05: 3 uses of actions/checkout@v4 and 3 of actions/setup-python@v5 remained across deploy-api.yml, freshness-alarm.yml and guardrail-watch.yml.
falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any workflow still names checkout@v4 or setup-python@v5. After the change: 10 checkout@v7 and 9 setup-python@v7 and no older versions. The three edited workflows still parse as YAML (python yaml.safe_load, jobs deploy / freshness / watch). pip install --dry-run -r scripts/requirements-maintenance.txt resolves; the same for requirements-test.txt failed locally on 'numpy>=2.5.3', a line this change does not touch, because the local Python is 3.11. CI runs 3.12 and is the real check for that file.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: PyPI decides which versions exist: pip index versions pytest printed 9.2.0 and hypothesis 6.170.14, both at or above the new lower bounds (9.1.1 and 6.168.3). The Action versions already in use on main (checkout@v7 and setup-python@v7 in 7 and 6 other workflow uses) are the precedent.

break_it.scenario: The deploy-api workflow breaks because checkout@v7 or setup-python@v7 behaves differently from v4 and v5.
break_it.what_happens: The Railway API deploy job would fail on a push to main, and the deploy would not run.
break_it.how: The same two actions at v7 are already used by 10 and 9 other uses in the gates and alarm workflows that run on every push, so v7 is exercised on this runner already. The edited file parses as YAML.

break_it.scenario: Raising the pytest lower bound to 9.1.1 forces a version that does not exist or cannot install on the CI Python.
break_it.what_happens: The Python tests job fails at install time, visibly, on this PR.
break_it.how: pip index versions pytest shows 9.2.0 exists. The gates run on this PR installs the file on the CI Python 3.12 before merge.

break_it.scenario: A lower bound change leaves an older pin elsewhere that now conflicts, for example scripts/requirements-maintenance.txt still saying pytest>=8.0.
break_it.what_happens: Two files would ask for different pytest ranges and one environment could resolve differently from the other.
break_it.how: Both files were changed to pytest>=9.1.1 and hypothesis>=6.168.3 together; grep for the old bounds finds none.

post_merge.manual_verify: No. Watch the next push to main: the deploy-api workflow should still run (it is the one workflow whose success the PR gates cannot show).
